 - Versus -
 The State of Jharkhand ...

Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath
-----

For the Petitioner : Mr. Rohan Mazumdar, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Kumari Rashmi, A.P.P.
---
04/06.02.2025 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Rajmahal P.S. Case No. 37 of 2024,
corresponding to G.R. Case No.376 of 2024, S.T. Case No.156 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 304(B) of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I,
Rajmahal.
Petitioner happens to be the husband of the deceased namely Guddiya Kumari, who died an unnatural death in her matrimonial home within five years of marriage.
It is alleged that the petitioner along with co- accused persons used to assault her to enforce the demand of dowry.
From the perusal of postmortem report, it appears that the deceased has sustained mechanical injuries.
From the F.S.L. report, it appears that the deceased has poisoned to death.
In view of the aforesaid facts, I am not inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail stands rejected.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
